name: v3 without http installs on a default build
v2 installs on a default build
read-only route on a default build
message: This plugin opens public endpoints on the server (route `GET,HEAD /.well-known/webfinger`, route `GET /users/{name}`, well-known `webfinger`). This AtomicServer was built without plugin routes, so the plugin can't be installed here.

name: read-only route on a feature build at off
message: This plugin opens public endpoints on the server (route `GET,HEAD /.well-known/webfinger`, route `GET /users/{name}`, well-known `webfinger`). The server operator hasn't enabled them. To allow it, start AtomicServer with `--plugin-routes read-only` (or `ATOMIC_PLUGIN_ROUTES=read-only`).

name: inbox POST at off names every surface
message: This plugin opens public endpoints on the server (route `GET,HEAD /users/{name}`, route `POST /users/{name}/inbox`, route `GET /nodeinfo`, route `PUT,DELETE /files/{*rest}`, well-known `nodeinfo`, write target `inbox-items`, key `actor-key`, token store `storage`, delivery `deliver`). The server operator hasn't enabled them. To allow it, start AtomicServer with `--plugin-routes read-write` (or `ATOMIC_PLUGIN_ROUTES=read-write`).
